title: Lane AI Labs — Zigzag, Summer, Dave
cta: Start at the home sky. Pick a planet. Get lost on purpose.
videoAgentPrompt:
Make a 60-second landscape (16:9) website intro for Lane AI Labs. Funny, cool, conversational.

THIS IS A MULTI-PERSON CONVERSATION. Three people are on camera together and talk TO EACH OTHER. Not three sequential solo talking-head clips. Not a round-robin of monologues. They interrupt, glance at each other, and finish each other's jokes — like a group chat that escaped onto a couch.

Three characters — use the attached photos as their faces. Do not invent new faces.
1) First image: ZIGZAG — green alien, dry, slightly processed, planetarium DJ energy.
2) Second image: SUMMER — hippie botanist, sunflower headband, tea-tint sunglasses, warm Southern California, unhurried, plants-and-peace.
3) Third image: DAVE — the human who built the site; warm, dry, a little proud, never salesy. Use the man's FACE from the photo; ignore poster text and props.

FRAMING NOTE: Summer's photo is nearly square and this video is landscape 16:9. Frame her from the chest up, centered, with generous headroom ABOVE her sunflower headband. Never crop the top of her head, her hair, or the sunflower. Extend the plant-lab background horizontally to fill 16:9. Do not add black bars.

FRAMING NOTE: Keep all three heads fully in frame whenever they share the shot. Medium shots, not extreme close-ups. Headroom on everyone.

Visual grammar: start on a three-shot (split or group). Cut to two-shots when they argue. Occasional MCU but always return to the group. They look at each other, not only the lens.

This script is a concept and theme to convey — not a verbatim transcript. You have full creative freedom to expand, elaborate, add examples, and fill the duration naturally. Do not pad with silence or pauses.

CONVERSATION
Zigzag (to camera, then to Summer): Signal acquired. Cute sky. Is this Earth?
Summer (cutting him off): That's the planetarium, spaceman. Don't eat the plants.
Dave (between them, grinning): That's Zigzag. That's Summer. I'm Dave. I built Lane AI Labs so they'd stop arguing in the group chat.
Zigzag (to Dave): Astronomy's the easy part. Tap a star, Carl talks, I look cool. You keep dragging me back to Earth.
Summer (to Zigzag): He means stars. I mean plants — trees, fish, a valley you can wander. Garden's twenty-one and over, so breathe.
Dave: Family wall. Dead shows. Home page — pick a planet.
Zigzag (to Dave): He always says that.
Summer (peace sign, to camera): Get lost on purpose.
Dave: Lane AI Labs.

CRITICAL ON-SCREEN TEXT
Lane AI Labs
Astronomy · Genealogy · Music · Plants
Start at the home sky

VISUALS
Cut on the jokes. Keep motion subtle. No stock office. No mortgage, no finance.

STYLE — PLAY MODE: Electric blue #3B8BFF, hot pink #FF2DAA, lime green #8CFF4C accents on dark night-sky black #0A1018. Bouncy but not childish. Oversized titles for the four words. Pop cuts on the punchlines. End on a clean title card: Lane AI Labs.

clips.name: Zigzag
clips.motionPrompt: dry alien presenter, slight head tilt, three-finger greeting, speaking to camera in a dark lab
clips.script: Signal acquired. I flew in for the sky. You've got a planetarium — tap a star, Carl talks, I just look cool. Astronomy's the easy part. The human named Dave keeps dragging me back to Earth. Start at the home sky.

clips.name: Summer
clips.motionPrompt: warm unhurried botanist, small smile, speaking to camera among plants
clips.script: Peace. He means stars. I mean plants — trees, fish, a whole valley you can wander. The garden page is twenty-one and over, so breathe. Don't mix the sky with the soil unless you're Dave.

clips.name: Dave
clips.motionPrompt: warm dry nod, proud not salesy, speaking directly to camera
clips.script: I'm Dave. I built Lane AI Labs so my alien, my botanist, and I would stop arguing in the group chat. Stars. Lane family. Dead shows. Plants. Home page — pick a planet. Get lost on purpose.
